title: Economics of Firm Strategy
description: Analysis of market competition and business strategy. Topics may include market analysis, competitive advantage, strategic positioning, industry dynamics, strategic commitment, organizational structure, and firm boundaries.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECON 413, ECON 485 (if taken in the same topic).
recommendations: ECON 345 or ECON 365, and ECON 358 recommended prior to ECON 413.
